description:
Hi,
 

 Greetings from Avance,
 

 Hope you are doing good!!!
 

 We have an urgent requirement related to your profile with one of our client for .Net Developer at Philadelphia, PA. If you are interested and available for the following position then please send your updated resume immediately.
 

 Job Title: .Net Developer
 Location: Philadelphia, PA
 Duration: Contract to hire/CTH
 Interview mode:Inperson
 (USC & GC's only)
 

 Job description:
 

 Responsibilities
 

 •Understand user stories and create solution design
 •Development per specifications
 •Stage Code Deployments
 •Participate in daily scrums
 •Work in continuous integration environment
 •Create technical user stories
 •Understand user stories and create solution design
 •Participate in and contribute to story point estimations   
 

 Experience
 

 •7-10 years experience in .NET development and web services integration
 •3-5 years Healthcare experience
 •Experience in working in global distributed Agile teams
 •Experience with Healthcare standards 5010, ICD10 and EDI transactions 270, 271, 276, 277.
 •3-5 years experience in creation of web services and APIs
 •Experience writing integrations for large transaction volumes       
 

 Skills
 

 •Strong .NET Strong .NET 4.0, C#, VB, IIS developer with web services and REST/JSON API development proficiency
 •Strong healthcare background with expertise in 5010 and ICD 10 EDI 270/271, 276/277 transactions
 •Agile and Test Driven Development expertise
 •Knowledge and expertise with databases such as SQL Server, Oracle and Sybase
 •Experience with integration middleware, specifically IBM MQ
 •Navinet and Navinet Open knowledge is a plus

 .NET Strong .NET 4.0, C#, VB, IIS developer with web services and REST/JSON API .

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
